package main

import (
	"fmt"

)

func main() {
	dir := "archive/"
	fmt.Println(dir + "/2026/" + "mar.txt")     // glued by hand: a double slash
	fmt.Println("archive" + "2026" + "mar.txt") // glued by hand: no slash at all
	fmt.Println(filepath.Join(dir, "2026", "mar.txt"))

	p := filepath.Join("archive", "2026", "mar.txt")
	fmt.Println("dir: ", filepath.Dir(p))
	fmt.Println("base:", filepath.Base(p))
	fmt.Println("ext: ", filepath.Ext(p))
}

temp.go.src:
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
)

func main() {
	dir, err := os.MkdirTemp("", "depot-*") // * becomes random digits
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println(err)
		return
	}
	defer os.RemoveAll(dir) // tidy up: delete the folder and everything in it

	f, err := os.CreateTemp(dir, "label-*.txt")
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println(err)
		return
	}
	fmt.Fprintln(f, "fragile")
	f.Close()

	name := filepath.Base(f.Name())
	fmt.Println("folder starts with depot-:", strings.HasPrefix(filepath.Base(dir), "depot-"))
	fmt.Println("file is label-<digits>.txt:", strings.HasPrefix(name, "label-"), filepath.Ext(name))
	data, _ := os.ReadFile(f.Name())
	fmt.Print("it holds: ", string(data))
}
